blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five V186 product views and six pose renders confirms shallower authored pleat relief, but angular folds and irregular faceted panels remain visible across the front, side, and back. In crouch the front hem lifts and leaves the shorts and upper thighs broadly exposed; in sit the overskirt bunches behind the pelvis and the thighs remain exposed. Pose deformation and customer coverage remain unacceptable.

The V186 views still show angular planar shading along the bodice side and a small gray patch near the waist; the rear waist flap also remains visibly stiff. The source and exact panel ownership of the front patch remain unverified. Bodice appearance is unacceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
